pages.title: AI Evaluation Lab
pages.subtitle: ProofGate / Release checks for coding agents / Startup Qatar START

blocks.text: AI Evaluation Lab helps engineering teams decide whether an AI-generated code change satisfies the agreed task contract. ProofGate connects the requirement, candidate artifact and qualified checks to a result that a reviewer can inspect and replay.
The problem and existing proof

A retained synthetic patch passed public tests while dropping inactive records. The qualified verifier rejected it. Across five synthetic tasks, the Lab retains 52 attempts: 44 passes, five failures and three holds. Three of 46 success claims with passing public tests failed the verifier. These are technical findings, not customer outcomes.
First buyer and paid offer

The initial buyer is a software engineering lead or coding-agent integrator with a recurring release decision. Proposed pricing is $5,000 for one task-family pilot, then $1,000 monthly for a bounded recurring workflow. Compare with the buyer's existing checks using independent held-out cases, review time and repeat use.
Market and route to customers

At an assumed $12,000 annual price and 10% qualification share, the 2022 U.S. Census software-publisher count gives a $20.19m reference scenario. Qatar CRA's 409 ICT listings give a separate $490,800 entry SAM scenario at assumed 10% serviceability. Neither share nor price is validated. Global TAM remains unmeasured.
What initial funding would produce

Request: $12,000 for three months of validation, covering $10,200 modeled costs plus reserve and rounding. Targets are 15 interviews, three assisted staging installs and one signed paid scope or budget-authorized LOI. Follow-on funding requires evidence, Qatar cost quotations and a new cash calculation before month 4.

Founder Rama Chandra Malayanur has published the Lab, built ProofGate and contributed a merged Backstage change. Expansion depends on a second team reusing the same task pack with less founder support.
Prototype, unincorporated. Historical accounts and personal Qatar commitments remain unresolved. Customer isolation is a development milestone. Named prospects are research targets only.

Discovery sequence

First establish the current release decision, checks and human effort. Seek one recent example and the owner who accepts or rejects it. Show the demonstration only after understanding the baseline. A synthetic or authorized staging task is sufficient for initial discovery.

Advance only when the engineering owner, budget route, authorized artifacts and unmet need are identified. Stop qualification if the current process is adequate, repository rights are unavailable or procurement is infeasible.
Local value and establishment

A successful pilot could support evaluation-engineering capability and a local hire. Formation, founder presence, eligible spending and employment costs must fit actual program terms. No local partner, entity, relocation or full-time commitment is assumed.

blocks.text: Report every denominator, false block, hold, execution error and unexecuted case. Include time spent resolving uncertainty and failures. Keep setup effort and end-to-end elapsed time visible. If the small sample fails a target, disclose it and revise or stop; do not drop cases or change labels after seeing results.
Economic threshold

At an assumed $50 per review hour, $1,000 monthly equals 20 review hours. That is a comparison point, not observed savings. The buyer must establish actual review cost, useful findings and willingness to pay. A faster report with hidden error-handling work does not establish value.

Independent human review requires a person separate from verifier implementation. AI-assisted QA does not satisfy that role. Thresholds are internal proposals, not official program rules or a production-accuracy claim.

blocks.text: Customer execution is a gated dependency

The current local runner is not a security sandbox. The proposed staging design requires disposable isolated execution, no production credentials, separate candidate/verifier write boundaries, restricted networking, resource limits and safe cleanup. Test tampering, state leakage, revoked access, cancellation and resource failures before customer code execution.

If review cannot establish the boundary within the budget, restrict demonstrations to trusted synthetic artifacts and defer execution of customer candidates. The buyer retains merge and release authority. Security remediation PR #34 remains open and separate.
Expansion follows reuse

Support approvals, commerce and administrative workflows require domain rules, authenticated observations and a qualified reviewer. The offline support prototype does not establish those integrations. Do not add multi-tenancy, billing or sector packs before repeated buyer need supports them.

blocks.text: Program alignment

START targets PoC/MVP ventures launching in Qatar. AI/ML and B2B SaaS are priority sectors. QDB also expects an unmet need, validated concept, researched business model, clear execution plan and detailed technology roadmap. The proposal addresses these topics, while customer validation and actual founder operating commitments remain open.

Actual Lab financial history, employee count, ownership, referral source, Qatar operations/hiring, residence and two-year availability. The public form has three attachments of up to 30 MB each, an accuracy declaration and a 30-day completion instruction. These cannot be completed by extrapolating from plans.
